title: 8 Great Speeches in History, Indian and World, and What Made Each One Work
seoTitle: Great Speeches: 8 Indian and World Speeches Explained
seoDescription: Great speeches from Vivekananda, Gandhi, Nehru and Ambedkar to Lincoln, Churchill, King and Mandela: dates, key lines, techniques and where to read them.
excerpt: Exact dates, one verified line each, the technique behind every speech and the official place to read it, plus seven habits students can borrow for assemblies, debates and interviews.
